risk: invalid input crashes or corrupts state
good: narrow validate and return typed error
false_positive_notes: known non-null internal invariant with proof is not a finding

risk: failed operation leaves UI or data falsely successful
evidence: inject failure and inspect state transition
good: preserve failed state and recovery action
false_positive_notes: logging-only catch with propagated error is acceptable

risk: completion order changes result or side effect
false_positive_notes: serial execution proven by owner contract is safe

risk: first last empty or maximum item behaves wrong
false_positive_notes: unreachable values should be excluded by validated contract

risk: duplicate policy diverges across callers
false_positive_notes: local policy is fine when callers intentionally differ

risk: initialization and change surface become coupled
false_positive_notes: type-only cycle with no runtime effect may be lower risk

risk: indirection hides one simple behavior
good: keep local or show volatility boundary
false_positive_notes: second consumer or real plugin boundary can justify it

risk: API can be called without policy
false_positive_notes: public endpoint with no protected resource is not an authz gap

risk: injection path or malformed data reaches interpreter
false_positive_notes: validated typed internal values need no duplicate parser

risk: credential or personal data exposure
false_positive_notes: public non-sensitive build metadata is not a secret

risk: SSRF traversal or arbitrary file access
false_positive_notes: static trusted path with no attacker input is safe

risk: N+1 latency and load
evidence: query count grows with item count
good: batch or prefetch with measured bound
false_positive_notes: small bounded list with explicit product limit may be acceptable

risk: typing/list interaction misses frame budget
evidence: profiler render count and data size
good: narrow owner or virtualization after measurement
false_positive_notes: measured small subtree with budget proof is not a finding

pattern: synchronous heavy work on event loop
risk: all requests stall
false_positive_notes: small bounded work should be stated as such

risk: memory grows with repeated flow
false_positive_notes: transient allocation returning to baseline is not retention

risk: lost update or duplicate effect
evidence: two overlapping callers and final state
false_positive_notes: serialized owner with documented lock is safe

risk: network timeout leaves unknown commit and retry duplicates
false_positive_notes: idempotent operation with proof is not a finding

risk: partial state after error
evidence: fail second write and inspect DB
false_positive_notes: eventually consistent workflow must document repair path

risk: old app or rollback cannot read data
false_positive_notes: offline one-shot system with backup and explicit version gate may differ

risk: clients cannot recover consistently
good: stable error code and validation shape
false_positive_notes: internal function with typed domain error may not need HTTP shape

risk: old consumer fails on deploy
false_positive_notes: all consumers atomically versioned can avoid compatibility window

risk: crash or stale navigation
evidence: await crosses unmount/dispose and writes state
false_positive_notes: operation owned by process lifetime not screen is safe

risk: screen reader or keyboard cannot operate
false_positive_notes: decorative noninteractive element is not a finding

risk: regression passes while real boundary is broken
good: assert observable behavior at lowest real level
false_positive_notes: mock is valid for unavailable nondeterministic external system

pattern: arbitrary sleep or retry hides flake
risk: slow nondeterministic CI and masked race
false_positive_notes: documented bounded polling of external state can be valid

risk: incident cannot join request/job/logs
evidence: request or job path without id
false_positive_notes: local pure function need not create correlation
